dashboard.title: Professional profile
dashboard.subtitle: Manage how you appear to customers as an individual professional.
dashboard.dangerZoneDescription: Deactivating your profile removes it from customer search until reactivated.

list.title: Available requests
list.subtitle: Service requests from customers that match your categories and service radius. Review one and create a quote to respond.
list.empty: No matching service requests right now. Make sure your professional profile is active, with service categories and a service radius configured.

detail.intro: This is a service request from a customer. Review the details below, then create a quote if you'd like to propose a price for the work.

createQuote.title: Create quote
createQuote.intro: This is a customer's service request. Create a quote describing the work and materials you propose, and the price you're offering to complete it.

list.title: My jobs
list.subtitle: Work created from quotes your customers have accepted.

list.title: My appointments
list.subtitle: Appointments from quotes your customers have accepted.
list.emptyDescription: Appointments appear here once a customer accepts one of your quotes.

list.title: My invoices
list.subtitle: Self-billed invoices MaestroYa has issued to you.
list.emptyDescription: An invoice is drafted automatically once a completed job's payment is released to you — this requires an active self-billing authorization.

detail.title: Invoice
detail.acceptIntro: MaestroYa has drafted this self-billed invoice on your behalf. Review the details below and accept it to confirm they are correct.
detail.documentReference: Document reference: {reference}… (tamper-evidence checksum only — not an electronic signature).

selfBilling.title: Self-billing authorization
selfBilling.subtitle: Control whether MaestroYa may issue self-billed invoices to you on completed jobs.
selfBilling.activeDescription: You have authorized MaestroYa to issue self-billed invoices (“facturación por el destinatario”) on your behalf for completed jobs. You can revoke this at any time.
selfBilling.inactiveDescription: Without this authorization, MaestroYa cannot issue self-billed invoices on your behalf, and self-billed invoices cannot be drafted for your completed jobs.
selfBilling.previouslyRevokedDescription: You revoked this authorization previously. You can grant it again below.

verification.title: Verification
verification.subtitle: Verify your identity to earn a “Verified professional” badge on your public profile.
verification.noProfile: You need a professional profile before you can request verification. <link>Create your professional profile</link>.
verification.notStarted: You have not started a verification request yet.

DRAFT.label: Not submitted
DRAFT.description: Upload at least one identity document (national ID, passport or driver's licence) and any supporting documents, then submit for review.

PENDING.label: Pending review
PENDING.description: Your request is in the review queue. We'll let you know once a reviewer has looked at it.

UNDER_REVIEW.label: Under review
UNDER_REVIEW.description: A reviewer is currently checking your documents. No action is needed from you right now.

APPROVED.label: Approved
APPROVED.description: You are a verified professional. A verified badge appears on your public profile.

REJECTED.label: Rejected
REJECTED.description: Your request was not approved. See the reason below — you can address it and resubmit.

RESUBMISSION_REQUIRED.label: Resubmission required
RESUBMISSION_REQUIRED.description: A reviewer needs you to update your request. Follow the instructions below, then resubmit.

verification.fileLabel: File (JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF, max {maxMb, number}MB)
verification.submitHint: You must have at least one identity document uploaded before submitting.

leads.title: Lead marketplace
leads.subtitle: Browse customer requests that match your services and area. Customer contact details are shared only after you purchase a lead.

card.contactNote: Contact details stay hidden until the lead is purchased.

empty.title: No leads available right now
empty.description: New leads that match your services will appear here. Please check back soon.

error.title: We couldn't load the leads
error.description: Something went wrong. Please try again.

leads.loadMoreError: We couldn't load more leads. Please try again.

leadCheckout.title: Buy this lead
leadCheckout.subtitle: Review the lead, pay the lead fee securely and get the customer's contact details once the payment is confirmed.

lead.heading: Lead
lead.contactNote: The customer's contact details are shown only after your payment is confirmed.

summary.heading: Order summary
summary.pending: The lead fee, IVA and total are shown as soon as you start the purchase. Nothing is charged until you pay.
summary.unavailable: The price breakdown for this purchase is not available.

review.title: Ready to purchase
review.description: Continue to see the exact total. You are only charged after you confirm the payment.

payment.title: Pay securely
payment.description: Enter your payment details to complete the purchase.

awaiting.title: Confirming your payment
awaiting.description: Your payment is being confirmed. This usually takes a few seconds. Please don't close this page.

timeout.title: Still confirming your payment
timeout.description: Confirmation is taking longer than expected. The contact details will appear once the payment is confirmed. You can check again or come back later.

confirmed.title: Lead purchased
confirmed.description: Your payment is confirmed. The customer's contact details are shown below.

failed.title: Payment failed
failed.description: The payment could not be completed. You can start a new purchase.

cancelled.title: Purchase cancelled
cancelled.description: This purchase was cancelled or has expired, so this lead can no longer be bought through it. You can browse other leads in the marketplace.

unavailable.title: Lead unavailable
unavailable.description: This lead is not available for purchase.

network.title: Connection problem
network.description: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

denied.title: We couldn't start this purchase
denied.description: This lead may no longer be available, or your account can't purchase it right now.

payment.title: Payment couldn't be started
payment.description: We couldn't prepare the secure payment. Please try again.

payment.heading: Payment details
payment.secure: Card details are entered in a secure form provided by Stripe and never reach MaestroYa's servers.
payment.declined: We couldn't process this payment. Please check your details or try another payment method.
payment.unavailable: The secure payment form couldn't be loaded.

contact.heading: Customer contact details
contact.error: We couldn't load the contact details. Please try again.
contact.denied: Contact details are not available for this purchase.
contact.name: Name

billing.title: Billing details
billing.subtitle: The legal details MaestroYa uses to invoice you for the leads you purchase.
billing.noProfile: Create your <link>professional profile</link> first to add billing details.
billing.notVerificationNotice: Saving this form does not verify your details. A MaestroYa administrator reviews them manually; this review is not a confirmation by a tax authority.

MISSING.label: No billing details yet
MISSING.description: Enter your legal name, tax ID and billing address. They are needed to invoice the leads you purchase.

PENDING_REVIEW.label: Awaiting review
PENDING_REVIEW.description: Your details are complete and waiting for review by MaestroYa. They are not verified yet.

VERIFIED.label: Verified
VERIFIED.description: MaestroYa has reviewed these details. If you change any of them, they will need to be reviewed again.

NEEDS_CORRECTION.label: Correction needed
NEEDS_CORRECTION.description: MaestroYa could not accept these details. Update them and save to send them for review again.

rejectionReason.TAX_ID_MISMATCH: The tax ID does not match the legal name provided.
rejectionReason.LEGAL_NAME_MISMATCH: The legal name does not match the tax ID provided.
rejectionReason.ADDRESS_INVALID: The billing address is incomplete or could not be accepted.
rejectionReason.OTHER: Please check all details and contact support if you need help.

form.legalName: Legal name or registered company name
form.legalNameHint: Exactly as registered with the tax authority.
form.taxIdHint: Spaces, dots and hyphens are ignored.
form.countryHint: Two-letter country code, e.g. ES, DE, FR.
form.saved: Billing details saved. They are now awaiting review; saving does not verify them.
form.changeWarning: Changing any of these details means they will need to be reviewed again.
